note: Token tables for internal/marking. Data, not code: add a token here with its source. Unknown tokens are refused, never guessed.

sources.dodm5200.01v2: DoDM 5200.01 Vol 2, Marking of Information, Change 4 (2020), Enclosure 3: banner order and collateral, SCI, SAP, AEA, FGI and dissemination markings. https://www.esd.whs.mil/Portals/54/Documents/DD/issuances/dodm/520001m_vol2.pdf
sources.32cfr2001: 32 CFR 2001.20-2001.26, ISOO marking rules; ISOO Marking Classified National Security Information, Rev 4 (2018). https://www.archives.gov/files/isoo/training/marking-booklet-revision.pdf
sources.icd710: ICD 710 (2013): the CAPCO Register and Manual is authoritative for IC markings; it is not publicly released, so only tokens also in the public DoD manual are listed. https://archive.dni.gov/files/documents/ICD/ICD-710.pdf
sources.cui-registry: NARA CUI Registry category markings, retrieved 2026-10-22. https://www.archives.gov/cui/registry/category-marking-list
sources.cui-ldc: NARA CUI Registry, Limited Dissemination Controls. https://www.archives.gov/cui/registry/limited-dissemination
sources.dodi5200.48: DoDI 5200.48 (2020): CUI replaces FOUO in DoD. https://www.esd.whs.mil/Portals/54/Documents/DD/issuances/dodi/520048p.PDF
sources.iso3166: Country trigraphs: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (Debian iso-codes). The IC uses GENC, which differs for a few entities (for example XKS); those are refused until added here.

sci.note: a token may carry a sub-compartment suffix, e.g. SI-G; the suffix is opaque

dissem.note: canonical order is table order; CUI limited dissemination controls are also accepted here so a joined high-water mark can carry them

cui_categories.note: specified categories carry SP- in the banner

release.note: REL TO and DISPLAY ONLY: USA first, then trigraphs, then tetragraphs, each alphabetical. Tetragraphs expand to their members for dominance; NATO membership as of 2024.

legacy.note: refused as a configured marking; in content, raised to CUI
